objects.taxonomy_description: Passenger car with retractable soft-top or hardtop roof mechanism. Roof material is fabric (canvas, vinyl) in black, tan, or matching body color, or retractable hardtop panels matching body paint. When top is down, interior upholstery is visible with roll bar or reinforced windshield frame. Body style is 2-door or 4-door with characteristic roof cut line. Weather stripping visible along door frames and windshield. Rear window is integrated into soft top or separate glass panel. Proportions match sedan base with modified roof structure. Folding mechanism seams visible at roof joints.
